inductive Lst (α : Type) where
  | nil : Lst α
  | cons : α → Lst α → Lst α

namespace Lst

def app {α : Type} : Lst α → Lst α → Lst α
  | nil,       ys => ys

def rev {α : Type} : Lst α → Lst α

  induction xs with
  | nil =>

    simp [app, rev]
